name: Woman
description: Identifies as a woman.

name: Man
description: Identifies as a man.

name: Trans woman
description: A woman who was not read as one at birth; her world may or may not have a word for it.

name: Trans man
description: A man who was not read as one at birth; his history is his own to share.

name: Non-binary
description: Neither wholly woman nor wholly man, and not especially interested in the argument.

name: Agender
description: Without gender — an absence rather than a third option.

name: Genderfluid
description: Their gender shifts over days or seasons, and they'll tell you where it's landed.

name: Bigender
description: Two genders held at once, or in alternation, both fully theirs.

name: Demigirl
description: Partly a woman, partly something else that has no shorter name.

name: Demiboy
description: Partly a man, partly something adjacent and unnamed.

name: Genderqueer
description: Deliberately outside the categories on offer, and comfortable there.

name: Questioning
description: Still working it out, and the working-out is part of who they are right now.

name: Recognised third gender
description: Their culture formally recognises a third social gender with its own rites and duties.

name: Ungendered construct
description: Built without a gender and unbothered by the omission — though others keep assigning one.

name: Construct with a chosen gender
description: Made genderless, and picked one anyway after some careful thought.

name: Seasonally shifting (fey)
description: Fey-touched: their gender turns with the seasons, and they find mortal fixity strange.

name: Caste-assigned gender
description: In their hive or clan, gender is a role assigned at maturity — they may have accepted it, or fled it.

name: Gender of their god's aspect
description: They take the gender of whichever face of their deity currently speaks through them.

name: Two-bodied
description: One person, two forms, each with its own gender — and one shared name.

name: Refuses the category
description: Considers gender a local custom they were never obliged to adopt.

name: Element-claimed gender
description: Their gender follows the element that claimed them at their naming-rite; change elements by custom, and the gender changes too.

name: Metamorphic gender
description: Their gender changes with each life stage of metamorphosis, and they name the new one the week it settles.

name: Standing-earned gender
description: Among their people, gender is earned through a feat recognised by elders, not assigned at birth — theirs came late, and cost them something.
